title: createUseStore
subtitle: Specialized Hook Factory
description: Create a bound hook for a specific store instance to avoid passing the store repeatedly.
content: The `createUseStore` utility creates a specialized version of `useStore` that is already bound to a specific store instance. This is the recommended way to use stores in larger applications as it improves ergonomics and maintains full type safety without the mental overhead of carrying store references everywhere.

rows.name: store
rows.description: The store instance to bind to the custom hook.

returns.description: A custom hook that accepts an optional selector and equality function.
